```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
load("spec_net.Rdata")
load("veg.Rdata")
```

```{r}
#cleaning data

# from [spec.data](http://spec.data) 
# 
# - drop: col 4:9, col 12:36 col 39:43 col 45:61, 63, 65:80, 82:83, 85:124, 128:148, 152:156, 
# - spec interaction-> WANT col 62 ="degree", 64 = "species.strength" 81 = "d" 84 = "rare.degree", 125 =  "SiteBeeAbundance" 126 = "SiteBeeRichness", 127=  "SiteBeeDiversity" 149 = "PollRichness" 150 = "PollAbundance" 151 = "PollDiversity", 157 = "VegAbundance", 158 = "VegRichness",  159 = "VegDiversity"
#lat = col 37, long = col 38
clean_spec.net <- spec.net %>%
  select("Site","SampleRound","Year", "GenusSpecies" ,"PlantGenusSpecies","species.strength", "d", "rare.degree", "SiteBeeAbundance", "SiteBeeRichness", "SiteBeeDiversity", "PollRichness", "PollAbundance","PollDiversity","VegAbundance", "VegRichness", "VegDiversity", "Lat", "Long")
    
#drop: col 1:6, 
clean_veg <- veg %>%
  select(-c(1:6))
### use to make histogram (barplot) for plant abundance  - top 4 non native, top 4 native 

```

```{r}
#and col with mutate for non-native with spec.net

clean_spec.net <- clean_spec.net %>%
  mutate(non_native_plant= ifelse(PlantGenusSpecies %in% non_native_veg, "non-native", "native"),
         non_native_bee= ifelse(GenusSpecies %in% non_native_poll, "non-native", "native"))%>%
  filter(Year == 2022:2025)%>% 
  mutate(group = ifelse(Year >= 2022 & Year <= 2023, "pre-fire", "post-fire"))
    

unique(clean_spec.net$PlantGenusSpecies[clean_spec.net$non_native_plant == "non-native"])
unique(clean_spec.net$GenusSpecies[clean_spec.net$non_native_bee == "non-native"])

#pre-fire filter(Year >= 2022 & Year <= 2023 )
#post-fire  filter(Year >= 2024 & Year <= 2025)
clean_spec.net
```

```{r}
#making new data frame for plants from clean_spec.net, include everything related to plants, drop otherwise. 
#then make pre and post df for plants 

plant_df <-clean_spec.net%>%
  select("Site", "SampleRound", "Year","PlantGenusSpecies", "non_native_plant", "group", "VegDiversity","VegAbundance")
print(plant_df)


obs_means <- plant_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarize(obs_veg_div = mean(VegDiversity))

obs_veg_div<- obs_means$obs_veg_div[obs_means$group == "pre-fire"] - obs_means$obs_veg_div[obs_means$group == "post-fire"]
obs_veg_div # = 0.07378341

perm_once_blocked <- function(df) {
  gp <- df$group
  for (m in unique(df$Site)) {
    idx <- which(df$Site == m)
    gp[idx] <- sample(gp[idx], replace = FALSE)
  }
  mean(df$VegDiversity[gp == "pre-fire"]) - mean(df$VegDiversity[gp == "post-fire"])
}

B <- 5000
vegD_perm <- replicate(B, perm_once_blocked(plant_df))

# Two-sided permutation p-value
pvalue_perm <- mean(abs(vegD_perm) >= abs(obs_veg_div))
pvalue_perm # =  0.7442
```
